instagram.caption:
What level is your café Korean? ☕

ㄱ Beginner — "아이스 아메리카노 하나 주세요" (One iced Americano, please.)
ㄴ Intermediate — "카페에 가면 콘센트부터 찾더라고요" (At a café, people look for an outlet first.)
ㄷ Advanced — "자리를 맡아 두다" (to save a seat)

Same topic, three steps. Each level has a free worksheet + a 50-word list, and a podcast episode to listen along.

Which one are you? Comment ㄱ, ㄴ or ㄷ 👇
Free worksheet — link in bio.
